label: <DEL> step of long sequences starting with 0 or b
explanation: Sparse feature (0.02% of steps). 84% of activation mass is at the delimiter step (<DEL> input, about to output original token 0); the rest is at the last 1-2 original tokens just before <DEL> or at the first copy step. Rate rises strongly with sequence length (L=9 and L=8 hold ~77% of mass) and with first original token being 0 or b (13x and 12x lift; together ~84% of mass). Contextual tokens such as t, 3, x, q, c, v appearing in the sequence mildly raise firing. It essentially never fires at t<4 or late in the copy phase. Precision is very low: only ~6% of long 0/b-initial sequences fire at <DEL>, and no simple token-set condition found raised precision above ~10%, so the exact gating condition beyond (delimiter, first token 0/b, long L) is not captured. Magnitude is highest at <DEL> in L=8-9 sequences beginning with 0.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=b (+4.10), orig0=0 (+3.81), in_tok=b (+3.28), orig2=t (+2.70), orig1=q (+2.66), phase=0 & in_tok=j (+2.42). Lower it: phase=2 (-4.60), recall_idx=-1 (-3.83), prev3_tok=- (-3.41), prev2_tok=0 (-2.45).
